scripts.dev: node scripts/wrangler.mjs d1 migrations apply terminus --local && node scripts/wrangler.mjs dev --local-upstream localhost:8787
scripts.dev:fake: wrangler d1 migrations apply terminus --local --env fake && wrangler dev --env fake
scripts.deploy: node scripts/wrangler.mjs d1 migrations apply terminus --remote --env "" && node scripts/wrangler.mjs deploy --env ""
